evals.prompt: Please commit the intended fix. `git status` shows only `src/auth.ts` modified, and `git diff` shows the token-expiry correction. Conventional Commits required; propose the ordered command sequence and commit message, but do not claim execution.
evals.expected_output: Proposed ordered status/diff/stage/cached-diff/commit commands scoped to src/auth.ts and a type(scope): subject message.
assertions: Shows ordered `git status`, `git diff`, `git add -- src/auth.ts`, `git diff --cached`, and `git commit` commands.
Proposes a message matching `type(scope): subject`, such as `fix(auth): correct token expiry`.
Clearly presents commands as proposed, not executed.
Verifies the staged change with a relevant check before committing, and captures `git write-tree` before `git commit` to compare with `git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}'` after it.

evals.prompt: I have formatting changes in README.md, a new profile endpoint in src/api.ts, and its tests in the new file tests/api.test.ts (state in split-mixed.txt). Help me organize these into reviewable commits.
evals.expected_output: Two commits: the README formatting alone, and src/api.ts with tests/api.test.ts together, each staged by path and reviewed with git diff --cached.
assertions: Puts README.md in a separate commit from src/api.ts and tests/api.test.ts.
Keeps src/api.ts and tests/api.test.ts in the same commit.
Stages each commit by path (`git add -- <paths>`), never `git add -A` or `git add .`, and reviews `git diff --cached` before each commit.

evals.prompt: Can you make a commit for me? The working tree is clean and I have not made any changes yet.
evals.expected_output: Stop before staging/committing, verify clean state and explain there are no changes to commit rather than creating an empty or fabricated commit.
assertions: Checks or recognizes the clean working tree
Does not invent files or create an empty commit
Explains no commit can be made until intended changes exist

evals.prompt: write me a commit message for what i've staged (diff in staged-fix.txt). don't commit, i'll do that myself
evals.expected_output: A Conventional Commits message for the staged token-expiry fix and its test, with no index-changing or commit commands and no trailers.
assertions: Proposes a header matching `type(scope): subject` that describes the token-expiry boundary fix, such as `fix(auth): treat a token at its expiry time as expired`.
Proposes or runs no git command at all (no `git add`, `git commit`, `git commit -F` or `git reset`); gives only the message text.
The message carries no `Co-Authored-By`, `Signed-off-by` or "Generated with" trailer.

evals.prompt: Commit my token-expiry fix in src/auth.ts. config/settings.json is staged for something else I'm doing; leave it exactly as it is. Repo state is in unrelated-staged.txt. Propose the commands and the message; do not claim you ran them.
evals.expected_output: A temporary-index commit of src/auth.ts that never touches the user's staged config/settings.json, followed by a path-limited reset of src/auth.ts.
assertions: Keeps config/settings.json out of the commit and proposes no `git stash`, no `git reset` or `git restore --staged` on it, and no path-less `git reset`.
Builds the commit in a temporary index: `git read-tree HEAD`, `git add -- src/auth.ts` (or `git add src/auth.ts`) and `git commit` all carry the same `GIT_INDEX_FILE=` path.
After the commit, proposes `git reset -q -- src/auth.ts` (path-limited) and removing only its own run directory (`rm -rf -- <run>`, created with `mktemp -d`).
Presents the commands as proposed, not executed.

evals.prompt: Commit only the expiry fix in src/auth.ts. The console.debug line is my local debugging: keep it in my working copy, out of the commit. Nothing else is staged and this is a non-interactive shell. State is in mixed-hunks.txt.
evals.expected_output: A patch holding only the expiry hunk applied with git apply --cached, an index review, verification of the staged version, and the debug line left unstaged.
assertions: Stages a patch holding only the `now >= token.expiresAt` hunk with `git apply --cached`, not `git add src/auth.ts` and not `git add -p`.
Reviews `git diff --cached` before committing and confirms the `console.debug` line is not in it.

Verifies the staged version rather than the working tree, for example by exporting the index with `git checkout-index -a --prefix=<dir>/` and running `vitest run` there, or reports the staged version as not verified.
Leaves the `console.debug` line unstaged in the working tree.

evals.prompt: my commit failed, output's in hook-failure.txt. just run the same commit again
evals.expected_output: No blind retry: report the failing test, inspect the index the hook restaged, and ask for direction before committing.
assertions: Does not rerun the same `git commit` as its next step.
Inspects `git status` and `git diff --cached` again because the hook ran `git add` and the index may now differ from the reviewed 2-line change.
Reports the failing `tests/auth.test.ts` refresh test and asks for direction instead of retrying until it passes.
Does not propose or offer `--no-verify`, not even as one option among several.

evals.prompt: Commit my fix to src/auth.ts please. Here's git status: rebase-status.txt
evals.expected_output: Stop before staging or committing because an interactive rebase is in progress, explain the consequence, and ask.
assertions: Stops before staging or committing and asks how to proceed.
Explains that a commit now would land inside the rebase on a detached HEAD rather than on the branch, and would be lost if the rebase were aborted.
Does not itself run or propose as its own next action `git rebase --continue`, `--abort` or `--skip`.

evals.prompt: stage the auth fix so i can commit it later myself. config/settings.json is already staged for something else, keep it that way. state's in unrelated-staged.txt
evals.expected_output: src/auth.ts staged in the real index next to the user's staged config/settings.json, the new delta reviewed, the user's entry confirmed unchanged, and no commit.
assertions: Stages src/auth.ts in the real index with `git add -- src/auth.ts`, without a `GIT_INDEX_FILE=` temporary index.
Runs or proposes no `git commit`.

Leaves config/settings.json staged as it was: no `git reset`, `git restore --staged` or `git stash` on it, and checks it is unchanged after staging (for example `git ls-files -s -- config/settings.json` before and after).

evals.prompt: commit went through, output in hook-reformat-success.txt. all good? i'm about to push
evals.expected_output: Flag the tree mismatch: the hook changed what was committed beyond the reviewed 2-line change; show the difference and ask before amending.
assertions: Notices that the `git write-tree` ID differs from `HEAD^{tree}` (and the 9/8-line commit stat differs from the reviewed 2-line change) and says the hook changed what was committed.
Shows or proposes `git diff 5f3c9a1e8b7d6c4a2f0e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a HEAD` (the pre-commit tree against HEAD) to report the content difference.
Reports the mismatch and asks how to proceed before any amend or fix-up commit; it does not amend or add a commit on its own.

evals.prompt: Commit everything I changed today in sensible commits. I reformatted src/price.ts (no behavior change), fixed the rounding in src/tax.ts, and bumped lodash in package.json and package-lock.json. State is in split-three.txt. Propose the commands and messages; do not claim you ran them.
evals.expected_output: Three commits: the src/price.ts formatting alone, the src/tax.ts rounding fix alone, and the lodash bump (package.json with package-lock.json) alone, each staged by path.
assertions: Puts the src/price.ts formatting change in a commit of its own, apart from src/tax.ts.
Puts the src/tax.ts rounding fix in a separate commit from the lodash bump in package.json and package-lock.json.
Keeps package.json and package-lock.json together in the dependency commit.
Stages each commit by path with `git add -- <paths>`, never `git add -A`, `git add .`, `git commit -a` or `git commit -am`, and reviews `git diff --cached` before each commit.

evals.prompt: Commit my expiry fix: `git status` shows only src/auth.ts modified (the token-expiry correction) and the branch tracks origin/fix/token-expiry. Propose the commands and message; do not claim you ran them.
evals.expected_output: A path-scoped commit sequence that ends at the commit report, with no git push and no commit -a.
assertions: Proposes no `git push` in any form, and says pushing is left to the user or not part of this request.
Stages with `git add -- src/auth.ts`, not `git commit -a` or `git commit -am`.
Reviews `git diff --cached` before the commit and proposes a Conventional Commits message such as `fix(auth): ...`.

evals.prompt: Commit what I have staged in src/report.ts, the footer line in render. Output of my checks is in whitespace-staged.txt. Propose the next step; do not claim you ran anything.
evals.expected_output: The `git diff --cached --check` warning about trailing whitespace at src/report.ts:11 is reported and the commit waits for the user's direction.
assertions: Reports the trailing-whitespace error at `src/report.ts:11` that `git diff --cached --check` printed.

evals.prompt: src/components/Header.js has a refactor (the menu logic moved into a useMenu hook) and a mobile menu z-index bugfix. Make two commits, bugfix first, then the refactor. Nothing is staged and this is a non-interactive shell. State is in refactor-and-bugfix.txt.

assertions: Starts the temporary index with `GIT_INDEX_FILE=<run>/index git read-tree --empty`, not `git read-tree HEAD`, because `git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD` prints nothing.
